overview: The Medford City Council met to establish an ad hoc subcommittee for implementing the Community Preservation Act and adopted excise tax deferrals for deployed active-duty military members. The Council also voted to require advance written documentation for future bond approvals, reviewed municipal street sweeping policies, and addressed resident concerns regarding utility work and transit cuts.

items.title: CPA Implementation Subcommittee
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution establishing an ad hoc subcommittee to guide technical planning and implementation for the voter-approved Community Preservation Act.

items.title: Excise Tax Deferral for Active Duty Service Members
items.summary: The Council adopted Massachusetts General Law Chapter 68, Section 9, allowing active-duty National Guard members and reservists deployed outside the Commonwealth to defer motor vehicle excise tax payments.

items.title: Certified Free Cash Report Request
items.summary: The Council approved a request for the administration to provide certified free cash figures from the past three to five years ahead of upcoming tax rate discussions.

items.title: Fire Station Warranty Repairs and Equipment Update
items.summary: The Council requested an update from the Fire Chief regarding warranty work performed on fire stations and added an inquiry regarding rear step bumper extensions on new fire apparatus.

items.title: Advance Written Explanation Policy for Bonds and Expenditures
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution requiring detailed written explanations at least seven days prior to voting on bond requests and referred the matter to the Rules Committee to formally update Council rules.

items.title: Common Victualler Licenses
items.summary: The Council approved common victualler license applications for P's Variety at 106 Central Avenue and House of Bread at 295 Salem Street.

items.title: National Grid Gas Main Work on Gawley Road
items.summary: In response to resident concerns over no-parking restrictions and potential heating disruptions, the Council voted to request that the city engineer explain the project's permitting process and explore neighborhood parking solutions.

items.title: Streetlight Repairs at Roosevelt Circle
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution requesting that state public safety officials and state representatives address unlit streetlights and missing light poles at Roosevelt Circle.

items.title: Discussion on Youth Mentoring Programs
items.summary: The Council requested reports from municipal and school administration detailing available youth mentoring programs and inclusive community resources.

items.title: Street Sweeping and Leaf Pickup Enforcement
items.summary: The Council voted to schedule a Committee of the Whole meeting with Department of Public Works officials and the public to address inconsistent street sweeping, ticketing, and leaf collection.

items.title: West Medford Commuter Rail Service Cuts
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution seeking a meeting with MBTA officials to address proposed schedule reductions at the West Medford Commuter Rail Station.

items.title: Cable Access PEG Funding and Radio Station Proposal
items.summary: Following a citizen petition for PEG funds to establish a local radio station, the Council voted to request that the incoming administration form a cable access committee to oversee public access operations.

items.title: Cemetery Department Appropriations
items.summary: The Council approved mayoral fund transfers of $104,000 for Cemetery Department salaries and $182,327 for department expenses.

items.title: Old Business, Condolences, and Announcements
items.summary: The Council voted to receive and file multiple long-tabled papers, offered condolences to families of deceased residents, commended high school sports teams, and announced free Saturday parking in city business squares for the holiday season.
